definition: A worldview is compatible with specified content d just when there is a world that satisfies all the worldview's accepted contents and also makes d true. For the objective-duty reading, the content d expresses the duty; its truth at the designated actual world is a separate hypothesis. Mere compatibility does not entail that the worldview explicitly endorses d.
note: Distinguishes consistency with an external norm from internal consistency. The existence and content of an objective duty are neither defined into reality nor proven by this logical test.
